scope: Actual Vue components with simulated IPC; not installed acceptance
checks: importing an entirely missing scene into a different configured library stores only a recoverable record; it does not switch library or replace the exact draft
cancel leaves no target record; importing the same source into a separate library is independently scoped
a changed real-file preflight requires a second explicit confirmation instead of silently applying a different partition
stale record CAS rejects a second-window rename without replacing its bytes or the current editor
a late tab-storage failure rolls back staged reading/search/reference metadata and preserves the exact dirty model
a legacy 130-file local scene continues in bounded 128/2 native batches while preserving the dirty active document; migration limits do not remove old local functionality
360 by 540 short viewport retains reachable actions and no horizontal page overflow
